title: Tooling check, default configs, cadence setting and self-adoption
goal: Require a formatter and linter for every stack and fold reconciliation into working PRs, released as 5.0.0
acceptance: check-tooling fails without formatter-check and lint scripts run in CI; renamed scripts and a recorded exemption are honoured
check-freshness reports the backlog as a note below the count and age limits and as a warning at either
The template formats and lints its own tools with the configuration it gives projects; fixtures pass unchanged in behaviour
privacy: Throwaway fixtures only; no project data.
validation: tools/test-tooling.mjs and the cadence fixture in tools/test-tools.mjs
check:template, test:tools, check:backlog, independent review, final CI and the published tag
escalation: Removing or weakening an evidence requirement needs owner agreement

effort.basis: Implemented 2026-11-11 in one change; owner approved scope and cadence the same day.
